(719)bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i ru mtshon mnga' gsol bzhugs/skye med rdo rje dbyings kyi yum chen mo/'gag med dpal ldan rang byung rgyal ma dang*/

tei:div.tei:p: bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i ru mtshon mnga' gsol bzhugs/ skye med rdo rje dbyings kyi yum chen mo/ 'gag med dpal ldan rang byung rgyal ma dang*/ dpal mgon sde lnga lcam dral bka' sdod bcas/ ye shes dbyings su dbu 'phang bstod par bgyi/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan stong pa'i gzugs/ kun khyab bde chen ngang du ro gcig (720)kyang*/ ma rig 'jin pa'i las rlung gis sprul pa'i/ g.yar dam gnyen po chos kyi dbyings su bsre/ 'das pa'i rnam par rtog pa yod do cog sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyan por spel/ ma 'ongs rnam par rtog pa gnas bsgyur nas/ da bcol legs pa'i zhu ba gcig tu 'bul/ chad pa'i gzhung cig bdag gis mi srong rgyu/ chad las don 'byung don la ma g.yel cig bcol pa'i phrin las khyod kyis mi mjad rgyu/ phrin (721)las don du gzugs skur bzhengs la dgongs/ dbu 'phang gnyan po de re mi bstod rgyu/ phyogs las rnam rgyal brtul zhugs 'jin pa'i phyir/ lhun po'i spo dang nyi zla'i bkrag mdangs kyang*/ rngom brjid yon tan 'bar ba'i dpyid du spungs/ snyigs ma lnga yi yang mthar lhung ba rnams/ nad mtshon dmag 'khrug mu ges mnar ba'i tshe/ skyabs 'os dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum/ dam can chos (722)srung rgya mtshor bzhengs la 'bod/ zhi ba phyogs gcig mya ngan mi 'da' ba/ sleb pa lam gyi dam bca'i mthar thug phyir/ stong nyid dbyings las snying rje'i sgyu thabs gar rnam bzhi'i phrin las rol mor mnga' gsol lo/ rta gdong me lce 'bar ba'i mu khyud nang*/ las dbang bsod nams klung rta dar drags pa'i/ dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi pa'i rtsibs rnon gyis/ gzhan sde'i brtan pa 'phrog par mnga' gsol lo/ kun (723)'byung 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras rnam rtog gi gzhan dbang nyid du yongs yer ma gzung yang*/ gang la gsol ba btab na yid bzhin don/ 'bad med 'grub pa'i nor bu mnga' gsol lo/

rang sde srung la shin tu mjangs bzhin du/ gzhan sde dbang byed sgyu rtsal la goms pas/ thabs la mkhas pa'i shes rab mig yangs mas/ khams gsum dbang byed btsun mor mnga' gsaul lo/ 'du 'ji'i gnas kyang bsdu ba'i (724)dngos po dang*/ tshangs gnas bzhi yi don la sbyor byed cing*/ 'byor zhing rgyas la srid sde srung mkhas pa'i/ khyim bdag rin chen mchog tu mnga' gsol lo/ rtag chad don la sems pa'i mu stegs dang*/ 'tshe ba chos su smra ba'i kla klo'i dpung*/ theg chen lus stobs rgyags pa'i sna zhags kyi/ ral gris gcod pa'i glang por mnga' gsol lo/ bskul par yud kyis phyin pa'i mgyogs pa'i dbang*/ rbad par thogs rdug med pa'i rlung (725)gi shugs/ pha rol ri rab yin yang rdzu 'phrul gyis/ rlalag byed rta mchog chen por mnga' gsaul lo/ legs nyes stangs 'jin bdag po khyed rnams ni/ rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi la mchog thob cing*/ stobs bcu mi 'jigs rnam bzhi'i rtsal rdzogs pas/ dgra sde 'joms pa'i dmag dpon chen por mjod/ khyad par rang srid 'byor pa'i mi ngoms par/ gzhan se bza' ba'i lha min 'jug pa can/ byed pa rgyu (726)mthun mtshon cha'i rno dbal rtser/ rang srog rang gis 'phrog par mnga' gsol lo/ gang la srung skyob byed pa'i lha srung dang*/ mja' gcugs dam bca'i re mo nyer bsubs la/ bstan 'gro'i phan bde bde bshig pa'i mdun gros dpung*/ nang dbyen me 'khrug sbyor bas spa bkongs shig rigs gsum mgon po mes dben rnam gsum gyis/ rgyal bstan gangs rir drangs pa chud gsan nas/ dge bcu'i khrims kyi mu khyud bshig pa rnams/ (727)don snying lkog mar 'byin par mnga' gsaul lo/ 'jig rten las kyis sprul pa'i gzhan dbang la/ phywa dang dbang phyug rang dbang yin zer na/ bden pa gnyis dang de yi bstan srung la/ bsten goms byas pa'i 'bras bu g.yel lam ci/ chos kyi sku ni dus gsum skye 'gag med/

longs spyod rdzogs las rnam sprul chos skyong rnams/ dam can nyid phyir dam tshig dang gzhes la/ lnga bdo'i 'gro 'di srung (728)skyob dus la bab/ mig 'phrul las kyang myur ba'i 'jig rten gyi/ rgud pa sna tshogs dam can chos srung mthus/ srung zhing khyad par bdag cag yon mchod la/ lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs nas grogs dan mjod/ gzhis su 'dug na rdzogs ldan dga' ston spel/ byes su gcan 'phrang chom rkun kha char srungs/ dgra dang 'gyed na dpa' rtags ru mtshon 'phyor/ phyogs las rnam rgyal bkra shis bde legs mjod/ ces pa'ang mda' dpon pha lha'i ngor rdzogs chen pa 'jigs med gling pas so/// /
